status: Executed geometric compatibility audit; not an ARK validation or a physical atom-displacement prediction
registration: Dextro z(+) to laevo r(+): inversion followed by basal Rz(pi), net diag(1,1,-1). Enantiomorph plus setting conversion, not a proper rotation of one specimen. Inherited ANSYS coefficients unchanged.
Z_field_control: Zero linear piezoelectric strain; relative residual is undefined, not evidence of successful nonzero-strain prediction

SiO_only_constraints.interpretation: Releasing internal angular rigidity removes the kinematic obstruction; no force law selects the physical motion yet

target_conditioned_shape_example.selector: Minimum squared fractional O-O changes, exact first-order Si-O lengths, zero mean translation
target_conditioned_shape_example.NOT: Predicted physical displacement, calibrated microscopic energy, or proof of large distortion/damage

guards.rounding_probe_interpretation: Sensitivity to printed-coordinate rounding only, not experimental confidence intervals
